This directory vendors the browser distribution of `libraw-wasm` 1.6.0.

- Project: https://github.com/ybouane/LibRaw-Wasm
- Package license: ISC
- Underlying decoder: LibRaw, distributed under its own LGPL/CDDL licensing terms
- Source project: https://www.libraw.org/

The vendored JavaScript and WebAssembly files are kept locally so GitHub Pages can run without a CDN after the first visit.
